checks.name: Native booking selection
checks.detail: Booking selection uses a compact real dropdown, preserves change handling and fits the mobile viewport.

checks.name: Searchable staff ownership
checks.detail: Search filters configured staff, unknown names cannot be selected, and the selected account persists after save and reload.

checks.name: Focused intake sections
checks.detail: Only one section is visible at a time; all five navigation buttons work and preserve unsaved review fields.

checks.name: Intake navigation flow
checks.detail: Section navigation stays in document flow without overlapping the visible source/review section at desktop and mobile widths.

checks.name: Digital PDF and scanned PDF
checks.detail: PDF.js extracted digital text; Tesseract processed an image-only PDF using local language assets; the original PDF persisted and appeared beside the draft after reload.

checks.name: Reviewed intake and manual handoff
checks.detail: Original source, missing contact gate, staff review, ready status, per-field/full copying and clipboard denial fallback were exercised with fictional data.

checks.name: Verification and persistence
checks.detail: Staff check and reference persisted after reload; completed fields were disabled and shared intake data stayed out of browser localStorage.

checks.name: Duplicate recovery and responsive keyboard flow
checks.detail: Duplicate extraction linked to the existing intake and prevented another draft; desktop, 390px and 320px captures had no horizontal page overflow; keyboard focus and dialog Escape were checked.

visualReview: Verified targeted desktop/mobile travel checker, intake scroll and public open-menu screenshots. Automated viewport overflow checks passed.
mapbox: External calls blocked deliberately; fallback, privacy and ETA state verified.
productionLimit: No real mailbox/OCR, ShiftCare writes, background jobs, payroll release, secure worker/client identities or device GPS certified.
